resources.name: Faolon
resources.author: Faolon12
resources.description:
The author's own character, and the example rig that comes with Luna Advanced Rig Systems: custom body, a swinging tail, wings that fold and open, ears and fringe with physics, a looping scarf, its own eyes and head states.

Unzip into BepInEx/plugins/AdvancedRigs/Rigs/ (you get a FaolonRig folder), or drop the zip into the editor to look at how it's made and build your own from it.
